title: Doki Doki Literature Club Plushies
description: adds all 4 DDLC characters as plushies!
body: Works only with OptiFine. To get each one, you'll have to rename carved pumpkin to either Sayori Plushie, Natsuki Plusie, Yuri Plushie or Monika Plushie. These plushies are based on skins made by Sayowi (https://www.planetminecraft.com/member/sayowi/) so big thanks to them.
